items.html: Now we have explained how Adam ha Rishon took from the entire Olam ha Zeh and his Guf was stretched over three Olamot Beria Yetzira Assiya too, and all is one. Thus we have explained the first Behina, how the Olamot were when Adam ha Rishon was created. We also explained how his Rosh and Garon were inside GE and his Guf in the rest of the Olam.
